name: com.enlitt.signin
description: Sign players in to your game with Enlitt. A secret-free client of the sign-in handler in your game's backend: it opens the browser, redeems the one-time code at your backend, stores the session token, and adds the Enlitt-Session header to your own requests.

samples.description: A uGUI button that signs the player in and then calls the game backend with the session header.
